description: x-primary keys replace id; relations and join tables use them

statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `customer` (
  `customer_no` integer PRIMARY KEY,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `name` text NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `customer_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `customer_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `customer_owner_index` ON `customer` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product` (
  `sku` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `title` text,
  CONSTRAINT `product_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `product_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `product_owner_index` ON `product` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `product_sale` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `product_id` text NOT NULL,
  `sale_id` blob NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `product_sale_product_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `product`(`sku`),
  CONSTRAINT `product_sale_sale_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`sale_id`) REFERENCES `sale`(`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `product_sale_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `product_sale_product_id_sale_id_unique` UNIQUE(`product_id`, `sale_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `product_sale_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `product_sale_product_id_index` ON `product_sale` (`product_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `product_sale_sale_id_index` ON `product_sale` (`sale_id`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `product_sale_owner_index` ON `product_sale` (`owner`)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sale` (
  `id` blob PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT (uuid7()) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
  `owner` blob,
  `visibility` text DEFAULT 'private' NOT NULL,
  `note` text,
  `customer_no` integer,
  CONSTRAINT `sale_customer_no_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_no`) REFERENCES `customer`(`customer_no`),
  CONSTRAINT `sale_owner_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`owner`) REFERENCES `user`(`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `sale_visibility_check` CHECK(`visibility` IN ('private', 'authenticated', 'public'))
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `sale_customer_no_index` ON `sale` (`customer_no`)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS `sale_owner_index` ON `sale` (`owner`)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `customer_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `customer`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `customer`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE `customer_no` = OLD.`customer_no`;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `product_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `product`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `product`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE `sku` = OLD.`sku`;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `product_sale_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `product_sale`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `product_sale`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS `sale_updated`
AFTER UPDATE ON `sale`
FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW.updated_at = OLD.updated_at
BEGIN
    UPDATE `sale`
    SET updated_at = CAST(
      (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 AS INTEGER
    )
    WHERE id = OLD.id;
END;

CREATE VIEW `customer_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`customer_no` AS `_key`,
  `t`.`customer_no` AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`name` AS `name`
FROM `customer` AS `t`

CREATE VIEW `product_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`sku` AS `_key`,
  `t`.`sku` AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`title` AS `title`
FROM `product` AS `t`

CREATE VIEW `product_sale_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`product_id` AS `product_id`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`sale_id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`sale_id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`sale_id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`sale_id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`sale_id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`sale_id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `sale_id`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', `r`.`sku`, 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'title', `r`.`title`) FROM `product` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`sku` = `t`.`product_id` LIMIT 1) AS `product`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', (CASE WHEN `r`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END), 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'note', `r`.`note`, 'customer_no', `r`.`customer_no`) FROM `sale` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`id` = `t`.`sale_id` LIMIT 1) AS `sale`
FROM `product_sale` AS `t`

CREATE VIEW `sale_view` AS
SELECT
  `t`.`id` AS `_key`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`id` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`id`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `id`,
  `t`.`updated_at` AS `updated_at`,
  (CASE WHEN `t`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`t`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END) AS `owner`,
  `t`.`visibility` AS `visibility`,
  `t`.`note` AS `note`,
  `t`.`customer_no` AS `customer_no`,
  (SELECT json_object('id', `r`.`customer_no`, 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'name', `r`.`name`) FROM `customer` AS `r` WHERE `r`.`customer_no` = `t`.`customer_no` LIMIT 1) AS `customer`,
  (SELECT coalesce(json_group_array(json_object('id', `r`.`sku`, 'updated_at', `r`.`updated_at`, 'owner', (CASE WHEN `r`.`owner` IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 1, 4))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 5, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 7, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 9, 2))) || '-' || lower(hex(substr(`r`.`owner`, 11, 6)))) END), 'visibility', `r`.`visibility`, 'title', `r`.`title`)), json('[]')) FROM `product` AS `r` JOIN `product_sale` AS `j` ON `j`.`product_id` = `r`.`sku` WHERE `j`.`sale_id` = `t`.`id` ORDER BY `r`.`sku`) AS `products`
FROM `sale` AS `t`
